periods.time: Climax of the second Tokyo defensive battle before reinforcements arrive
periods.location: Tokyo Bay sky and multiple front-line locations
periods.summary: When Upton fires Enterprise's main cannon at Tokyo's underground shelter, Kurono awakens Three Thousand Worlds. She rewinds and repeatedly interferes with the same time interval, creating accumulated results in which she appears across the battlefield and defeats the PSYON clones threatening the front. The price is catastrophic bodily recoil: by the time she returns to Upton, she is soaked in blood and barely able to stand, but she has stopped the first Justicefier shot and bought ten minutes.
periods.cause: Upton's hadron cannon is about to kill the civilians sheltering underground, including Kurono's family, and Kurono's new understanding of family as support lets her cross the door she had avoided since leaving KOK.
periods.process: Kurono breaks free from EDY wires and appears in the cannon's path, destroying the guns with aging bullets. Reports then show many Kuronos simultaneously fighting PSYON. Itsuki and Upton infer the truth: she has returned to the same time point over and over, personally fighting more than two hundred Abrahams in overwritten intervals and leaving each result accumulated in the present.
periods.outcome: PSYON's breakthrough is temporarily halted and Tokyo is saved from immediate annihilation. Kurono is left unable to continue fighting, making the battle depend on the reinforcements she bought time for.
periods.significance: A major character awakening that proves Kurono's family strengthens rather than weakens her, and neutralizes the most dangerous PSYON phase of the invasion.
